title: Understanding Sample Efficiency in Predictive Coding
abstract: arXiv:2605.11911v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Predictive Coding (PC) is an influential account of cortical learning. Much of recent work has focused on comparing PC to Backpropagation (BP) to find whether PC offers any advantages. Small scale experiments show that PC enables learning that is more sample efficient and effective in many contexts, though a thorough theoretical understanding of the phenomena remains elusive. To address this, we quantify the efficiency of learning in BP and PC through a metric called ``target alignment'', which measures how closely the change in the output of the network is aligned to the output prediction error. We then derive and empirically validate analytical expressions for target alignment in Deep Linear Networks. We show that learning in PC is more efficient than BP, which is especially pronounced in deep, narrow and pre-trained networks. translated_title: 理解预测编码中的样本效率
translated_abstract: 预测编码是一种有影响力的皮层学习理论解释。近期的许多研究工作集中于将预测编码与反向传播进行比较，以探究预测编码是否具有任何优势。小规模实验表明，预测编码在许多情境下能够实现样本效率更高且更有效的学习，但对这一现象的透彻理论理解仍然缺失。为了解决这一问题，我们通过一个名为“目标对齐”的度量指标来量化反向传播和预测编码中的学习效率，该指标衡量网络输出的变化与输出预测误差之间的对齐程度。随后，我们推导并通过实证验证了深度线性网络中目标对齐的解析表达式。我们表明，预测编码中的学习比反向传播更高效，这一优势在深层、狭窄和预训练网络中尤为显著。我们还推导出预测编码中保证最优目标对齐的精确条件，并对我们的发现进行了验证。
tldr: 该论文提出“目标对齐”度量指标，从理论和实证上证明预测编码的学习样本效率优于反向传播，尤其在深层、狭窄和预训练网络中优势显著。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the "target alignment" metric and theoretically proves and empirically validates that Predictive Coding achieves higher sample efficiency than Backpropagation, with the advantage being especially pronounced in deep, narrow, and pre-trained networks.
